cohort: The study included 71 pregnancies associated with cancer, divided into two groups: those who underwent termination of pregnancy and those who continued pregnancy.
finding: The rate of termination of pregnancy remains high, particularly in cases of non-breast cancer and early pregnancy detection, and scheduled preterm birth is frequent when pregnancy is continued to optimize cancer management.
mod_finding: A high rate of scheduled delivery (78.4%) was observed in the continued pregnancy group to optimize maternal oncologic management.
gest_age: Median gestational age at diagnosis was 9 weeks in the termination of pregnancy group and 22 weeks in the ongoing pregnancy group; 35.5% of continued pregnancies resulted in induced prematurity.
